description: The three provider workspaces every model call is billed to by its purpose (ws-control-plane, ws-hosted-loops, ws-ci-gates): each with its daily spend limit, rate limit, today's spend and calls (UTC day), and the platform ceiling above all three. Site admins with an admin-scoped token only. Mirrors GET /api/v2/admin/ai-workspaces. Returns {day, platformDailyCents, workspaces:[{workspace, purpose, dailyCents, rpm, spentToday, callsToday, callsLastMinute, updatedAt, updatedBy}]}.
name: gluecron_list_ai_workspaces
